title: Fuzzy skin (extrusion mode): keep slicer E targets

edits:
def move(self, newpos, speed):
        if not self.e_enable:
            self._do_actual_move(newpos, speed)
        
        de = newpos[3] - self.commanded_pos[3]
        
        # 分支1：大幅度移动，直接执行，清空历史累积（避免溢出或压力提前干扰）
        if de == 0 or abs(de) >= 1.0:
            self.e_accumulator = 0.0
            self._do_actual_move(newpos, speed)
            return

        # 分支2：极小量，仅累积
        if abs(de) < self.e_d:
            self.e_accumulator += de
            if abs(self.e_accumulator) < self.e_d:
                return

        # 分支3：常规移动，合并累积量并执行
        target_pos = list(newpos)
        target_pos[3] += self.e_accumulator
        self.e_accumulator = 0.0
        
        self._do_actual_move(target_pos, speed)

    def move(self, newpos, speed):
        # Preserve slicer XYZE targets; do not re-accumulate absolute E positions.
        self._do_actual_move(newpos, speed)
